diagnosticReview: Setup replays 120 locomotion steps then the old frame-3 bot through combat frame 38; both traces reject failed actions and frame/harness errors.

TAA, motion blur and DOF are rejected. Two fixed-frame real-render warmups populate scene depth and the depth mirror; scalar render clocks and ping-pong indices are reset before each warmup and each variant.

Each variant restores original FX visibility and scalar state before its single intervention. All selected FX meshes have depthWrite false, so these ablations do not alter the depth source used by later variants.

Seven native images are produced: two initial baselines, four ablations and a restored baseline. Each uses the real pipeline, verifies GL status and fixed frame/time, runs sampleFrame shader/finite/HUD apparatus checks, inspects HUD-unoccluded PNG pixels, preserves the HUD sidecar, and verifies screenshot time did not advance.

stableControl requires exact PNG hashes across both initial baselines and restored baseline. A mismatch is explicitly diagnostic-inconclusive. Stable repeated controls alone do not establish reproduction of the reported artifact or causality; the output limitation requires both before A/B interpretation.
The [diagnose] workflow can collect diagnostic evidence even if input rehearsal fails, while the job retains that failed step and never substitutes diagnostics for the skipped full video.
